contradictions.detail: The listing's service summary shows 98,363 mi in January 2024 but 88,354 mi in March 2024. Mileage cannot go backwards. Adjacent entries (84,460 Oct 2022; 100,056 May 2024) suggest the 88,354 entry is misdated (likely 2023). The seller calls it a clerical error by the previous owner. The actual Carfax and logbook should confirm.
The listing states 2.7L; the NHTSA decode returns 2.9L. No 2013 981 used a 2.9, so this is very likely a decoder error rather than an identity problem. Confirm with the window sticker and COA.

No borescope is mentioned. This is a bonus item and not held against the car.

The listing lists only 'sport exhaust tailpipes' (tips), implying a factory system with cats intact. No underside or exhaust photos were examined here.

documentation.rationale: The identity and terms half is present: VIN, window sticker, COA, a clean FL title (with lien), and a Carfax with dated services including brake fluid in 2022 and 2026. The maintenance half is incomplete. The water pump at 60k and the logbook are seller claims not seen here, there is no coolant service date, and the DME report was not examined. condition.rationale: Cosmetic flaws are disclosed (scratches, headlight oxidation, seat wear). An aftermarket airbag steering wheel of unconfirmed origin is fitted. The car has 107.7k miles with no clutch or DMF history and a ~47k-mile-old claimed water pump. On the positive side, the axle and bearing work and brake fluid are recent, and the seller reports a strong clutch and no leaks, but nothing is proven by inspection.

price_value.rationale: The fair value estimate is $29.8k–34.1k, but the comps are 24k–78k-mile cars. At 107.7k miles with the clutch/DMF window open and cosmetic and modification items, a likely hammer in the high $20s is roughly market rather than a bargain. The current $15,250 bid is not indicative five days out.

mission_fit.rationale: Porsche is on the active exclusion list and deferred to 2027-28. This is a keeper-type purchase that conflicts with the current cash-preservation plan and the roughly $25k all-in target for a fun manual daily. A soft top on a 13-year-old car also needs proof of sound seals and drains for year-round rain use.

logistics.rationale: The car is in Maitland, FL, on a remote no-reserve auction closing Nov 6. PPI access is not stated and must be arranged within days. emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Desirable traits are present: a 6-speed manual, a non-black Luxor Beige interior, and Dark Blue Metallic paint. Against that, it is a base 2.7 without PASM or Sport Chrono noted, with taste-dependent decals and 20-inch wheels, and an aftermarket airbag wheel that detracts.

evidence.mission_note: Porsche is on Jason's active exclusion list and deferred to 2027-28, so this is attractive only as a future keeper. Buying it now conflicts with the current cash-preservation plan and the roughly $25k all-in target for a manual daily.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2013 981 Boxster base 2.7 with a 6-speed manual, Dark Blue Metallic over Luxor Beige, a clean FL title (lien to be paid off), and a clean Carfax as reported. Carfax-summarised dated services include brake fluid in 2022 and 2026, plugs in 2022, a battery in 2025, and a left-rear axle and bearings in March 2026. Observed issues are disclosed cosmetic wear and headlight oxidation, an aftermarket steering wheel whose airbag the seller cannot confirm as genuine, and one out-of-sequence Carfax mileage entry that is likely a dating error but unconfirmed. Open items centre on the 9A1's major risks at 107.7k miles: the DME over-rev report was posted but not examined here, there is no PIWIS scan, there is no clutch/DMF record, and the water pump at 60k is a seller claim without a dated document. Recall 21V679000 completion, top function and drains, and tyre spec are also unverified. The comps behind the fair value estimate are much lower-mileage cars, so the likely hammer sits near market for this mileage. Porsche is currently an excluded, deferred marque in Jason's plan.
evidence.next_action: Before Nov 5, ask the seller for the logbook lines (water pump, coolant, clutch), the full Carfax page for the 88,354-mile entry, and recall 21V679000 status, and book a mobile Porsche-specialist PPI in Maitland. Do this only if Jason decides to reopen the deferred Porsche option.
